Action: A critical water crisis has hit El Obeid as ongoing war and drone strikes have shut down key supply lines and power networks. With over 3 million residents, including thousands of displaced families, now facing severe shortages, water prices have doubled, forcing many to rely on unsafe sources. While the "Suqia" initiative and emergency drilling campaigns are rushing mobile tankers and new wells to the hardest-hit areas, humanitarian groups warn of a looming health catastrophe if fuel shortages and blockades continue to choke out the city's remaining backup systems.
